gaps.note: The page never says how the coefficient stream is laid out as a padded array nor in which axis order it starts (the paper, line 4231, says numerical order of k is lexicographic in (a_d,...,a_1), with padding inserted by a nested scan, lines 4232-4247). Without this the reader cannot see why a reordering, or why a reversal of all axes, is needed, nor that the padding scan costs O(Tp).

The page does not say what one equal-width chunk interchange costs (O(Tp ell^tau)), nor how the O(d^2) swaps, the linear passes, the shifts and the padding scans combine into the stated bound; the reader cannot check the formula from the page. It also omits the paper's hypotheses for the shift offsets to cost o(Tp) (t_i >= r/2 and r exceeding every fixed power of p, paper lines 4278-4281).
